number: 第二百四十八条の四の二
heading_en: Submission of an Application for Approval of the SA-CVA
summary_ja: SA―CVAの承認を受けようとする最終指定親会社は、商号等を記載した申請書に理由書等を添付して金融庁長官に提出する。
summary_en: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking approval for the SA-CVA submits to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency an application stating its trade name and responsible person, with the listed attachments.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval under paragraph (1) of the preceding Article for the use of the SA-CVA shall submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency an application for approval stating the following matters. (i) Trade name. (ii) The name and title of the person responsible for ascertaining and managing the consolidated capital adequacy ratio.

The following documents shall be attached to the application for approval in the preceding paragraph. (i) A statement of reasons. (ii) The curriculum vitae of the person responsible provided in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph. (iii) Documents showing that the calculation of the CVA risk equivalent amount, the construction and use of the exposure measurement model, and other operation of the SA-CVA conform to the standards for approval provided in Subsection 3. (iv) Documents stating other matters for reference in the examination relating to the approval.
